description: Healthy Food Guide looks up packaged foods by UPC, name or description and returns published healthy food related scores like Longevity and Food Integrity. Users can find the healthiest foods by category or compare which foods are healthier. Results include scores, ingredients, nutrition information, things to watch out for, and links to more detailed nutrition information tied to specific user goals.
